# PARTICIPANT INVENTORY BY RUNG

**Everyone and everything that has produced evidence for JRS, laid out along the evidence ladder rather than by study number. Generated by `research/build_participant_inventory.py`. Human rows are read from the roster CSV, not re-transcribed, so this file and the reviewer roster cannot disagree about a person.**

> **OWNER COPY. DO NOT FORWARD.** The Arm B section shows the arm split, and **the split is the blind.** Everything public or buyer-facing is counts only.

---

## The ladder

| Rung | Question it answers | Judged by | Participants |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Rung 1** | Do independent AI models apply JRS alike? | **AI models, no humans** | 3 models across 3 vendors |
| **Rung 2a** | Do independent human reviewers agree with one another? | Humans | 25 |
| **Rung 2b** | Do reads match a key fixed before scoring? | Humans | 16 |
| **Arm B** | Does JRS improve on unaided review? | Humans | 20 |
| **Rung 3** | Do flagged records fail when challenged? | **Case contributors, not reviewers** | 2 |

**Rung 1 and Rung 3 carry no reviewer panel of their own.** That is why neither appears in `REVIEWER_ROSTER_COMPLETE.md`, and it is a property of the design rather than a gap in the record.

---

## Rung 1: Reproducibility

**Judged by machines.** Each constructed record is put to one model per provider, and the measure is how often independent vendors return the same read. Runs nightly from `api/run-study.js`, so the figure is continuously re-checked rather than frozen.

**The panel, from the most recent recorded run (2026-08-15T06:06:08.448977+00:00):**

| Vendor | Model |
|---|---|
| anthropic | `claude-opus-4-8` |
| openai | `gpt-5` |
| google | `gemini-flash-latest` |

Mode: **cross_vendor**. With a non-Claude key present the harness runs cross-vendor and escalates a label only when two or more vendors agree; with neither present it falls back to three same-provider models, which is a weaker independence signal and is labelled as such.

**Human participants: none, by design.**

---

## Rung 3: Criterion validity

*Do flagged records actually fail when challenged?*

**Carried by case contributors, not reviewers.** A contributor submits real, de-identified records together with their documented outcome, so a JRS read can be compared against what actually happened. Read live from `realcase_progress`.

| Domain | Contributor | Cases | Challenged | Failed appeal | Held up | JRS ready | JRS review | JRS gap | Last case |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Public records / FOIL | `E-08` | **32** | 7 | 15 | 5 | 18 | 9 | 5 | 2026-08-08 |
| HR / Employment | `V-HR-01` | **22** | 6 | 7 | 7 | 13 | 6 | 3 | 2026-07-29 |

**2 contributors, 54 cases in total.**
